label: rare: late original-phase / <DEL> steps in sequences starting with z, w, 1 or k
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.03% of steps). It fires mostly (84% of mass) at original-phase steps t>=3 (peaking at t=4-6) and at <DEL> (10%), almost only in sequences whose first token is z, w, 1 or k (about 90% of activations). It never fires at t<3, and almost never in the copy phase except near the end of long sequences. The context predicate has high recall (0.89 dev) but precision is only 0.5%: within that context the feature fires on a small, combinatorial subset. That subset is enriched for the second token being k/w/b, the third being j/v/h/b/3, and the current input being a digit 0-2 or d/m. Stacking these conditions only gets precision to about 9% while recall drops to about 22%. No simple predicate captures it. Magnitude is narrow (median 0.12, max 0.22), and I found nothing clear that modulates it.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=z (+5.00), orig0=w (+4.98), orig0=1 (+3.84), orig1=w (+3.61), orig0=k (+3.27), phase=2 & in_tok=1 (+2.91). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-4.08), phase=2 (-3.07), prev_tok=w (-2.62), orig3=q (-2.48).
